name: Spicy Beef, Bok Choy & Mushroom Stir-Fry with Jasmine Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board; slice crosswise into thin strips. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and stir-fry until almost cooked through, about 4 minutes. Transfer steak to a plate and set aside. (Reserve pot with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry green onions and bok choy. Using a clean cutting board, trim and cut the onions and bok choy crosswise into 1-inch pieces.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 small bunches green onions (scallions)
9 baby bok choy

instructions.primary_message: Return the pot (with drippings) to medium-high heat. Add green onions, bok choy, and mushrooms; stir-fry until veggies are fork-tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.

When the rice is almost done, return steak strips (and any accumulated juices) to the pot. Add stir-fry and chili-garlic sauces, then set over medium-high heat. Cook, stirring occasionally until combined and warmed through, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup stir-fry sauce
2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
